launchRule: Launch is blocked until all four pillars are verified with a real successful output in production.

pillars.label: AI-generated Vocal Cuts
pillars.generationPath: ElevenLabs text-to-speech → 48 kHz WAV → four HSC variations
acceptance: A voice can be selected and generated from a phrase.
Each variation exports as a 48 kHz WAV after the approved unlock path.
pillars.blocker: Provider credits are exhausted; production output has not been re-verified.

pillars.label: Own recorded / curated HSC vocals
pillars.generationPath: Local microphone recording → HSC processing → four 48 kHz WAV variations
acceptance: A user can record a take locally without uploading it.
The take can be processed into four variations.
The curated HSC vocal source and its usage rights are explicitly selected before launch.
pillars.blocker: Local recording path exists, but no approved curated HSC vocal library or licensing decision is recorded.

pillars.label: Transition FX
pillars.generationPath: ElevenLabs sound generation → 48 kHz WAV → four HSC variations
acceptance: A transition type and character can be selected.
A generated transition can be previewed.
Four variations export as 48 kHz WAV after the approved unlock path.
pillars.blocker: Provider credits are exhausted; production output has not been re-verified.

pillars.label: DJ Tools
pillars.generationPath: ElevenLabs sound generation → 48 kHz WAV → four HSC variations
acceptance: A DJ tool and character can be selected.
A generated DJ tool can be previewed.
Four variations export as 48 kHz WAV after the approved unlock path.
pillars.blocker: Provider credits are exhausted; production output has not been re-verified.

sharedLaunchGates: Production audio generation is tested successfully for AI vocals, Transition FX and DJ Tools.
The own-recording path is tested in a production browser and the curated-vocal decision is documented.
The approved payment/unlock path is tested without exposing secrets: successful payment unlocks all four WAV downloads.
One approved 9:16 HSC asset exists for each pillar before any launch scheduling begins.

publishing.rule: Do not schedule or publish until the shared launch gates are complete and the owner explicitly approves the first post.
